description: This file defines the class Zend_Http_Response_Stream, a subclass of Zend_Http_Response, which manages HTTP responses involving stream resources. It includes methods for handling streams, cleaning up resources, and constructing responses from string data.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Response_Stream
classes.description: A class that extends Zend_Http_Response to handle HTTP responses with streamed content, providing methods to access, set, and manage the stream resource, as well as cleanup mechanisms.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns the current stream resource associated with the HTTP response.

methods.name: setStream
methods.description: Sets the stream resource for the response.

methods.name: getCleanup
methods.description: Returns whether cleanup (file unlinking) is enabled.

methods.name: setCleanup
methods.description: Enables or disables cleanup of the stream file upon object destruction.

methods.name: getStreamName
methods.description: Retrieves the filename associated with the stream.

methods.name: setStreamName
methods.description: Sets the filename associated with the stream.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the response object, initializing with provided HTTP response data, including handling of resource-based body input.

methods.name: fromStream
methods.description: Creates an instance of Zend_Http_Response_Stream from a string response and stream resource.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Retrieves the response body as a string, reading from the stream if necessary.

methods.name: getRawBody
methods.description: Retrieves the raw response body as transferred on the wire.

methods.name: readStream
methods.description: Reads the content from the stream resource into the body property and closes the stream.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that closes the stream resource and removes the associated file if cleanup is enabled.
